description: This file contains a custom assertion class `ThingErrorResponseAssert` for validating properties and exceptions related to `ThingErrorResponse`. It is used in testing scenarios to facilitate assertions on `ThingErrorResponse` objects, verifying headers, status codes, types, and exceptions.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponseAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for `ThingErrorResponse`, providing methods to assert headers, status code, type, and exceptions in test cases.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected Ditto headers.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the response has empty Ditto headers.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the response contains the expected correlation ID.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Asserts that the response type matches the expected type.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the response's HTTP status code matches the expected code.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Asserts that the response contains the expected `DittoRuntimeException`.

methods.name: containsDittoRuntimeExceptionOfType
methods.description: Asserts that the response contains a `DittoRuntimeException` of the specified type.

methods.name: dittoRuntimeExceptionHasErrorCode
methods.description: Asserts that the exception has the expected error code.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method to assert that two values are equal with a custom error message.
